page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8t-4x.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by KVM virtualization. The instance couples host compute resources with dedicated accelerators, featuring 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs derived from 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 6462C processors. Host memory totals 512 GB of RAM, establishing an allocation ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Acceleration is provided by four NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture GPUs offering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM.

Network throughput is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid inter-node data exchange and host-to-cloud communication. The instance includes no complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and local instance storage is absent. As a result, all persistent file storage, operating system disks, and application data pipelines must rely on attached remote network volumes.

From an architectural standpoint, the allocation of four discrete Ada Lovelace accelerators alongside 512 GB of system memory supports memory-dense graphics pipelines and parallelized machine learning jobs. Because local NVMe storage is omitted, high I/O throughput workloads may experience bottlenecking over network storage channels unless volume striping or external caching tiers are integrated. Cost efficiency centers on its consolidated quad-GPU density, enabling users to execute parallel GPU tasks without provisioning multiple independent single-accelerator virtual machines.

This server instance is suitable for distributed machine learning training, multi-stream deep learning inference, 3D graphics rendering, computer vision processing, and accelerated parallel computing tasks.
